workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: synthesizes reset evidence, fail-closed c04 coverage, and measured reindex evidence into a route decision
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: branch synthesis only; no measured rollout, repair execution, training, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if synthesis treats offtrack-dominated matched-subset reindex as driver improvement
stop if synthesis ignores c04 exclusion
stop if synthesis routes to another artifact-only local-search step without new evidence
stop if synthesis routes directly to training or PPO
fallback_plan: route to scenario-quality reassessment if current-sim offtrack semantics dominate
route to c04 source-coverage repair if outcome-failure-surface coverage is essential
route to high-fidelity backend design if current-sim local repair is exhausted
stop for user review if no bounded evidence-producing route is supported

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2430 synthesizes scenario/task-quality infrastructure and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2430; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If the branch is offtrack-dominated and c04-excluded, do not route to training or ranking; choose synthesis/pivot/stop or a bounded evidence-producing route.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, candidate-family ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: integrates reset evidence and measured reindex evidence into a branch pivot away from source-linked local repair
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: moves toward task-quality decision evidence, but cannot establish current-sim or paper verdict

the synthesis decision is continue pivot stop or promote_to_next_branch

decision_rule: M2430 passes if it synthesizes M2425-M2429 and selects a next evidence-producing non-ranking route or stops without measured rollout, repair, training, ranking, or verdict claims.
